notes.title: Tofradyr
notes.content:
[h1]Magic Axolotl may have a sequel.[/h1]

The name is [b]Tofradyr[/b]. It's going to be launched on Kickstarter at April 15, 2023.

[b]Tofradyr [/b]is the continuation of the story with more characters, more enemies, bosses and more levels.

[b]Kickstarter[/b]: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gatoalebrije/tofradyr

notes.title: Improvement on spell recognition
notes.content: The game recognize better the vertical line and the lightning spell.
